# Captain's Log - or `Caps-Log` for Short

`Caps-Log` is a small, terminal-based journaling tool.

![Caps-Log Screenshot](./caps-log.gif)

## What It Does

- Daily entries saved as Markdown files
- Sections and tags for organizing entries (level 1 headers for sections, 
  unordered lists starting with '*' for tags)
- Two menus for navigating sections and tags
- Browse tags under a specific section or all tags 
- Calendar view highlighting dates with mentions of selected tags or sections, 
  providing a visual representation of habits and activities
- Calendar view highlighting dates with log entries, allowing you to see when you 
  wrote something
- Calendar view highlighting dates with annual events, such as birthdays and
  holidays, allowing you to see when you have an event coming up
- Open log entries in your preferred editor using `$EDITOR` environment variable
- Primitive remote storage feature using a git repository with a remote for 
  pushing and pulling data
- Scratchpad feature for quick note-taking without creating a new log entry
- Encrypted logs using AES encryption algorithm for added security

**Note**

- Emoji handling is somewhat erratic, potentially due to an FTXUI issue or
  misuse on my part. This could also be an issue with my font or terminal
  emulator. When an emoji is drawn, it shifts all other characters to the right
  by one place.
- The tool is not optimal for use in small terminals. While still functional, it
  performs best when the entire calendar is visible.

## Keybindings

| Keybinding | Action |
|------------|--------|
| `Tab` / `Shift + Tab` | Switch focus between the calendar and menus |
| `hjklr` / arrow keys | Navigate within the calendar or menus |
| `Enter` |  Open the log entry in `$EDITOR` for the date under the cursor |
| `d` | Delete the log under the cursor if the calendar is focused |
| `s` | Toggle scratchpad mode |
| `+` / `-` | Navigate to the next / previous year's calendar |

## Log Entry Tags and Sections

`Caps-Log` stores all logs as simple Markdown files to enable syntax
highlighting in your editor.

__Sections__

To mark a section, use: `# Section Name`. All text below until the next section
is considered part of it. By default, the first line of the file
is ignored when identifying section titles, as it's commonly used for the date
of the entry. This behavior can be configured via command line arguments or a
config file.

__Tags__

Tags can be added to the log entry by starting a line with `* Tag Name`. Tags
can belong to a section, but they don't have to. If they don't belong to a
section, they are considered to belong under a `<root section>` which is 
displayed in the section menu as a separate section.

- `* Tag Name`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information)`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information): A multiline body that is ignored by Caps-Log`

## Encrypting Logs

`Caps-Log` can encrypt your logs using the AES encryption algorithm. 
If you open an encrypted log repo, you will be prompted to enter a password. 
In case you enter a wrong password, caps-log will notify you end exit.
Same if you provide a password for a non encrypted log repository.

```
# Note: Caps-Log will ignore files not matching the log filename format.
# You can also provide --log-dir-path and --log-filename-format to control behavior.
# Encrypt
caps-log --encrypt --password <your password>
# Decrypt
caps-log --decrypt --password <your password>
```

__Config File__

most of the command line flags can be set through a config file.

```ini
log-dir-path=/path/to/log/dir
log-filename-format=%y_%d_%m.txt
sunday-start=true
first-line-section=true
password=your-password
```

Config file also allows configuring caps-log to treat the directory where logs
are stored as a git repository with a remote set-up. Upon exiting, `caps-log`
will commit and push all changes to the remote. Note that currently, only the
remotes with ssh authentication are supported. Here is an example of a config
file for git remote log repository.

```ini
# NOTE: this must be a path to a directory that is 
# inside the git.repo-root, otherwise `caps-log` will fail to start.
log-dir-path=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/days

[git]
# setting it to false, or not setting it at all is the 
# same as not having the below options defined
enable-git-log-repo=true 
ssh-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa # required
ssh-pub-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa.pub # required
repo-root=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/
remote-name=something # 'origin' is the default
main-branch-name=main # 'master' is the default

```

__Annual events__
Caps-log can also be configured to display annual events in the calendar. They 
will be highlighted with green color and number of days since or until the event (if the 
total number of days is less that `recent-events-window` days) will be displayed in the
small box to the left of the calendar.
```ini
[calendar-events]
recent-events-window=60

[calendar-events.birthadays.0]
name=Joe
date=18.07
[calendar-events.birthadays.1]
name=Jane
date=03.07.
[calendar-events.holidays.0]
name=New Year
date=01.01.
[calendar-events.holidays.1]
name=New Years eve
date=31.12.
```

__Theme__

You can override the annual view theme via config sections. Each section accepts
`fgcolor`, `bgcolor` and style flags: `italic`, `bold`, `underlined`, `dim`,
`inverted`, `strikethrough`, `blink`.

Only the sections you define are overridden; any missing sections keep the built‑in defaults.

Border styles:
- `light`, `dashed`, `heavy`, `double`, `rounded`, `empty`

Color formats:
- `rgb(R,G,B)`
- `rgba(R,G,B,A)` (alpha is ignored but must be 0-255)
- `ansi16(NAME)` or `ansi16(0-15)` (e.g. `brightred`)
- `ansi256(N)` (0-255)
- `#RRGGBB`
- `Default`

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme.log-date]
fgcolor=rgb(12,34,56)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.empty-date]
fgcolor=ansi256(244)
dim=true

[view.annual-view.theme.highlighted-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(yellow)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.weekend-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(blue)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.event-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(brightred)
bgcolor=ansi256(123)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.todays-date]
fgcolor=#00ffaa
italic=true
```

You can also override border styles for individual components:

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme]
calendar-border=double
calendar-month-border=light
tags-menu.border=heavy
sections-menu.border=dashed
events-list.border=empty
log-entry-preview.border=rounded

# or as dedicated subsections:
[view.annual-view.theme.tags-menu]
border=heavy
```

# Captain's Log - or `Caps-Log` for Short

`Caps-Log` is a small, terminal-based journaling tool.

![Caps-Log Screenshot](./caps-log.gif)

## What It Does

- Daily entries saved as Markdown files
- Sections and tags for organizing entries (level 1 headers for sections, 
  unordered lists starting with '*' for tags)
- Two menus for navigating sections and tags
- Browse tags under a specific section or all tags 
- Calendar view highlighting dates with mentions of selected tags or sections, 
  providing a visual representation of habits and activities
- Calendar view highlighting dates with log entries, allowing you to see when you 
  wrote something
- Calendar view highlighting dates with annual events, such as birthdays and
  holidays, allowing you to see when you have an event coming up
- Open log entries in your preferred editor using `$EDITOR` environment variable
- Primitive remote storage feature using a git repository with a remote for 
  pushing and pulling data
- Scratchpad feature for quick note-taking without creating a new log entry
- Encrypted logs using AES encryption algorithm for added security

**Note**

- Emoji handling is somewhat erratic, potentially due to an FTXUI issue or
  misuse on my part. This could also be an issue with my font or terminal
  emulator. When an emoji is drawn, it shifts all other characters to the right
  by one place.
- The tool is not optimal for use in small terminals. While still functional, it
  performs best when the entire calendar is visible.

## Keybindings

| Keybinding | Action |
|------------|--------|
| `Tab` / `Shift + Tab` | Switch focus between the calendar and menus |
| `hjklr` / arrow keys | Navigate within the calendar or menus |
| `Enter` |  Open the log entry in `$EDITOR` for the date under the cursor |
| `d` | Delete the log under the cursor if the calendar is focused |
| `s` | Toggle scratchpad mode |
| `+` / `-` | Navigate to the next / previous year's calendar |

## Log Entry Tags and Sections

`Caps-Log` stores all logs as simple Markdown files to enable syntax
highlighting in your editor.

__Sections__

To mark a section, use: `# Section Name`. All text below until the next section
is considered part of it. By default, the first line of the file
is ignored when identifying section titles, as it's commonly used for the date
of the entry. This behavior can be configured via command line arguments or a
config file.

__Tags__

Tags can be added to the log entry by starting a line with `* Tag Name`. Tags
can belong to a section, but they don't have to. If they don't belong to a
section, they are considered to belong under a `<root section>` which is 
displayed in the section menu as a separate section.

- `* Tag Name`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information)`
- `* Tag Name (Additional Information): A multiline body that is ignored by Caps-Log`

## Encrypting Logs

`Caps-Log` can encrypt your logs using the AES encryption algorithm. 
If you open an encrypted log repo, you will be prompted to enter a password. 
In case you enter a wrong password, caps-log will notify you end exit.
Same if you provide a password for a non encrypted log repository.

```
# Note: Caps-Log will ignore files not matching the log filename format.
# You can also provide --log-dir-path and --log-filename-format to control behavior.
# Encrypt
caps-log --encrypt --password <your password>
# Decrypt
caps-log --decrypt --password <your password>
```

## Configuration & Command Line Options

__Command Line Options__

```
Allowed options:
  -h [ --help ]                         Show this message.
  -c [ --config ] arg                   Override the default config file path
                                        (~/.caps-log/config.ini).
  --log-dir-path arg (=~/.caps-log/day/)
                                        Path where log files are stored.
  --log-name-format arg (=d%y_%m_%d.md) Format in which log entry markdown
                                        files are saved.
  --sunday-start                        Display Sunday as the first day of the
                                        week.
  --first-line-section                  Treat the first line of a log entry as a
                                        section title instead of ignoring it.
  --password arg                        Password for encrypted log repositories
                                        or to be used with --encrypt/--decrypt.
  --encrypt                             Apply encryption to all logs in the log
                                        directory path (requires --password).
  --decrypt                             Apply decryption to all logs in the log
                                        directory path (requires --password).
```

__Config File__

most of the command line flags can be set through a config file.

```ini
log-dir-path=/path/to/log/dir
log-filename-format=%y_%d_%m.txt
sunday-start=true
first-line-section=true
password=your-password
```

Config file also allows configuring caps-log to treat the directory where logs
are stored as a git repository with a remote set-up. Upon exiting, `caps-log`
will commit and push all changes to the remote. Note that currently, only the
remotes with ssh authentication are supported. Here is an example of a config
file for git remote log repository.

```ini
# NOTE: this must be a path to a directory that is 
# inside the git.repo-root, otherwise `caps-log` will fail to start.
log-dir-path=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/days

[git]
# setting it to false, or not setting it at all is the 
# same as not having the below options defined
enable-git-log-repo=true 
ssh-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa # required
ssh-pub-key-path=/Users/me/.ssh/id_rsa.pub # required
repo-root=/Users/me/.caps-log/clog-entries/
remote-name=something # 'origin' is the default
main-branch-name=main # 'master' is the default

```

__Annual events__
Caps-log can also be configured to display annual events in the calendar. They 
will be highlighted with green color and number of days since or until the event (if the 
total number of days is less that `recent-events-window` days) will be displayed in the
small box to the left of the calendar.
```ini
[calendar-events]
recent-events-window=60

[calendar-events.birthadays.0]
name=Joe
date=18.07
[calendar-events.birthadays.1]
name=Jane
date=03.07.
[calendar-events.holidays.0]
name=New Year
date=01.01.
[calendar-events.holidays.1]
name=New Years eve
date=31.12.
```

__Theme__

You can override the annual view theme via config sections. Each section accepts
`fgcolor`, `bgcolor` and style flags: `italic`, `bold`, `underlined`, `dim`,
`inverted`, `strikethrough`, `blink`.

Only the sections you define are overridden; any missing sections keep the built‑in defaults.

Border styles:
- `light`, `dashed`, `heavy`, `double`, `rounded`, `empty`

Color formats:
- `rgb(R,G,B)`
- `rgba(R,G,B,A)` (alpha is ignored but must be 0-255)
- `ansi16(NAME)` or `ansi16(0-15)` (e.g. `brightred`)
- `ansi256(N)` (0-255)
- `#RRGGBB`
- `Default`

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme.log-date]
fgcolor=rgb(12,34,56)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.empty-date]
fgcolor=ansi256(244)
dim=true

[view.annual-view.theme.highlighted-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(yellow)
bold=true

[view.annual-view.theme.weekend-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(blue)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.event-date]
fgcolor=ansi16(brightred)
bgcolor=ansi256(123)
underlined=true

[view.annual-view.theme.todays-date]
fgcolor=#00ffaa
italic=true
```

You can also override border styles for individual components:

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme]
calendar-border=double
calendar-month-border=light
tags-menu.border=heavy
sections-menu.border=dashed
events-list.border=empty
log-entry-preview.border=rounded

# or as dedicated subsections:
[view.annual-view.theme.tags-menu]
border=heavy
```

Markdown preview theme (for the log entry preview):

```ini
[view.annual-view.theme.log-entry-preview.markdown-theme]
header1=ansi256(220)
header2=ansi256(150)
header3=ansi256(115)
header4=ansi256(110)
header5=ansi256(117)
header6=ansi256(109)
list=ansi16(blue)
quote=ansi16(magenta)
code-fg=ansi16(brightblack)
```

Scratchpad view theme:

```ini
[view.scratchpad-view.theme]
menu.border=double
preview.border=rounded

[view.scratchpad-view.theme.preview.markdown-theme]
header1=ansi256(220)
header2=ansi256(150)
header3=ansi256(115)
header4=ansi256(110)
header5=ansi256(117)
header6=ansi256(109)
list=ansi16(blue)
quote=ansi16(magenta)
code-fg=ansi16(brightblack)
```

import subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib, textwrap
def run(args, cfg_content=None, cfg_name="config.ini", extra_files=None):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        td=pathlib.Path(td)
        logdir=td/"logs"; logdir.mkdir()
        cfg=td/cfg_name
        if cfg_content is not None:
            # replace LOGDIR placeholder
            cfg.write_text(cfg_content.replace("LOGDIR", str(logdir)))
        # extra files in logdir
        if extra_files:
            for k,v in extra_files.items():
                (logdir/k).write_bytes(v if isinstance(v,bytes) else v.encode())

import subprocess, pathlib, tempfile, os
def trial(pw="pw", content="# Title\n\n# Work\n* coding\nhello world plain 12345\n"):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        td=pathlib.Path(td); home=td/"home"; home.mkdir(); logdir=td/"logs"; (logdir/"y2026").mkdir(parents=True)
        cfg=td/"c.ini"; cfg.write_text(f"log-dir-path={logdir}\n")

trial(content="0123456789abcdef")
print("--- short ---")
trial(content="hi\n")

import subprocess,time,pathlib,os,shutil
def tm(*a): return subprocess.run(["tmux"]+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True)
def cap(s,esc=False):
    a=["capture-pane","-t",s,"-p"]
    if esc:a.append("-e")
    return tm(*a).stdout
def launch(base_name, cfg_text, files=None, env_cmd="export EDITOR=cat;", w=180,h=45, extra_args=""):
    base=pathlib.Path(f"/tmp/{base_name}")
    if base.exists(): shutil.rmtree(base)
    (base/"home").mkdir(parents=True); (base/"logs").mkdir()
    (base/"config.ini").write_text(cfg_text.replace("LOGDIR",str(base/"logs")).replace("BASE",str(base)))
    if files:
        for k,v in files.items():
            p=base/k; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_bytes(v.encode() if isinstance(v,str) else v)
    sess=base_name; tm("kill-session","-t",sess)
    cmd=f"export HOME={base}/home; {env_cmd} cd {os.getcwd()}; ./executable -c {base}/config.ini {extra_args}; echo EXITED:$?; sleep 100"
    tm("new-session","-d","-s",sess,"-x",str(w),"-y",str(h),cmd); time.sleep(0.8)
    return base,sess
def send(s,*k,wait=0.5): tm("send-keys","-t",s,*k); time.sleep(wait)

    mid=cap(sess)

import sys,datetime; sys.path.insert(0,"/tmp"); from drv import *; from cellparse import *
# events Oct8 Thu empty, Oct9 Fri today empty, Oct10 Sat log, Oct12 Mon log-other, Feb30 invalid
cfg="""log-dir-path=LOGDIR
[calendar-events.cat.0]
name=E8
date=08.10
[calendar-events.cat.1]
name=E9
date=09.10
[calendar-events.cat.2]
name=E10
date=10.10
[calendar-events.cat.3]
name=E12
date=12.10
[calendar-events.cat.4]
name=Feb30
date=30.02
"""
files={"logs/y2026/d2026_10_10.md":"# Sat\n","logs/y2026/d2026_10_12.md":"# Mon\n# Sec\n* tag\n","logs/y2026/d2026_03_02.md":"# Mar2\n"}
base,sess=start("capsEVStyle",cfg, files=files)
def report(label):
    rows=parse_rows(cap(sess,True)); scr=cap(sess).splitlines()
    print(label,scr[0].strip())
    def style(month,day):
        # month box layout normal 4 per row at 180: determine origin
        row=(month-1)//4; col=(month-1)%4; boxtop=1+row*9; y0=boxtop+2; x0=68+col*23+1
        first=datetime.date(2026,month,1); firstcol=first.weekday(); p=firstcol+day-1; y=y0+p//7; x=x0+(p%7)*3
        cells=[cell(rows,x+k,y) for k in range(3) if cell(rows,x+k,y) and cell(rows,x+k,y)[0]!=' ']
        return (day,cells[0][1:] if cells else None,(x,y))
    print(" Oct",[style(10,d) for d in [8,9,10,12,13]])
    print(" Feb/Mar",[style(2,28),style(3,1),style(3,2),style(3,3)])
report("sections focus no selection")
send(sess,"Tab"); send(sess,"Tab"); report("calendar focus")
send(sess,"Tab"); send(sess,"Tab"); send(sess,"Tab"); send(sess,"Tab") # preview->sec->tags? cycle 4: calendar->preview->sec->tags->cal? let's just BTab x? report irrelevant
tm("kill-session","-t",sess)

# ---------------- AES-128 (encrypt block only) + CFB128 ----------------

def _gf_mul(a,b):
    p=0
    for _ in range(8):
        if b&1: p ^= a
        hi = a & 0x80
        a = (a<<1) & 0xff
        if hi: a ^= 0x1b
        b >>= 1
    return p

def _make_sbox():
    sbox=[]
    for x in range(256):
        if x==0:
            inv=0
        else:
            inv=0
            for y in range(1,256):
                if _gf_mul(x,y)==1:
                    inv=y; break
        s = inv ^ ((inv<<1)|(inv>>7)) & 0xff ^ ((inv<<2)|(inv>>6)) & 0xff ^ ((inv<<3)|(inv>>5)) & 0xff ^ ((inv<<4)|(inv>>4)) & 0xff ^ 0x63
        # The above expression grouping in Python is not the affine transform; recompute properly:
        def rot(v,n): return ((v<<n)|(v>>(8-n))) & 0xff
        s = (inv ^ rot(inv,1) ^ rot(inv,2) ^ rot(inv,3) ^ rot(inv,4) ^ 0x63) & 0xff
        sbox.append(s)
    return sbox
_SBOX=_make_sbox()
_MUL2=[_gf_mul(x,2) for x in range(256)]
_MUL3=[_gf_mul(x,3) for x in range(256)]
_TE0=[]; _TE1=[]; _TE2=[]; _TE3=[]
for x in range(256):
    s=_SBOX[x]; s2=_MUL2[s]; s3=_MUL3[s]
    _TE0.append((s2<<24)|(s<<16)|(s<<8)|s3)
    _TE1.append((s3<<24)|(s2<<16)|(s<<8)|s)
    _TE2.append((s<<24)|(s3<<16)|(s2<<8)|s)
    _TE3.append((s<<24)|(s<<16)|(s3<<8)|s2)
_RCON=[1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128,27,54]

def _aes_key_expand(key):
    # key 16 bytes -> 44 words
    w=[int.from_bytes(key[i:i+4],'big') for i in range(0,16,4)]
    for i in range(4,44):
        t=w[i-1]
        if i%4==0:
            # RotWord then SubWord
            t = ((_SBOX[(t>>16)&0xff]<<24)|(_SBOX[(t>>8)&0xff]<<16)|(_SBOX[t&0xff]<<8)|_SBOX[(t>>24)&0xff]) ^ (_RCON[i//4-1]<<24)
        w.append(w[i-4]^t)
    return w

def _aes_encrypt_block(block, round_keys):
    a0=int.from_bytes(block[0:4],'big') ^ round_keys[0]
    a1=int.from_bytes(block[4:8],'big') ^ round_keys[1]
    a2=int.from_bytes(block[8:12],'big') ^ round_keys[2]
    a3=int.from_bytes(block[12:16],'big') ^ round_keys[3]
    Te0=_TE0; Te1=_TE1; Te2=_TE2; Te3=_TE3
    for rnd in range(1,10):
        rk=round_keys[rnd*4:rnd*4+4]
        b0=Te0[(a0>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a1>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a2>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a3&0xff]^rk[0]
        b1=Te0[(a1>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a2>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a3>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a0&0xff]^rk[1]
        b2=Te0[(a2>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a3>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a0>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a1&0xff]^rk[2]
        b3=Te0[(a3>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a0>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a1>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a2&0xff]^rk[3]
        a0,a1,a2,a3=b0,b1,b2,b3
    # final round
    S=_SBOX; rk=round_keys[40:44]
    out=bytearray(16)
    words_in=[a0,a1,a2,a3]
    # Construct output words then xor rk
    def final_word(w0,w1,w2,w3):
        return ((S[(w0>>24)&0xff]<<24)|(S[(w1>>16)&0xff]<<16)|(S[(w2>>8)&0xff]<<8)|S[w3&0xff])
    o0=final_word(a0,a1,a2,a3)^rk[0]
    o1=final_word(a1,a2,a3,a0)^rk[1]
    o2=final_word(a2,a3,a0,a1)^rk[2]
    o3=final_word(a3,a0,a1,a2)^rk[3]
    return o0.to_bytes(4,'big')+o1.to_bytes(4,'big')+o2.to_bytes(4,'big')+o3.to_bytes(4,'big')

def evp_key_iv(password_bytes):
    d1=hashlib.md5(password_bytes).digest()
    d2=hashlib.md5(d1+password_bytes).digest()
    return d1,d2

def aes_cfb128(data: bytes, password_bytes: bytes, decrypt=False):
    if not data:
        return b''
    key,iv=evp_key_iv(password_bytes)
    rk=_aes_key_expand(key)
    out=bytearray(len(data))
    feedback=iv
    pos=0
    while pos < len(data):
        ks=_aes_encrypt_block(feedback, rk)
        chunk_len=min(16, len(data)-pos)
        chunk=data[pos:pos+chunk_len]
        enc=bytes(c ^ ks[i] for i,c in enumerate(chunk))
        out[pos:pos+chunk_len]=enc
        if chunk_len==16:
            feedback = chunk if decrypt else enc
        pos += chunk_len
    return bytes(out)

# ---------------- CLI parsing (Boost program_options-like) ----------------

@dataclass
class Cli:
    help: bool=False
    config: Optional[str]=None
    log_dir_path: Optional[str]=None
    log_name_format: Optional[str]=None
    sunday_start: bool=False
    first_line_section: bool=False
    password: Optional[str]=None
    encrypt: bool=False
    decrypt: bool=False

_OPTIONS=[
    # canonical, short, takes_value
    ('help','h',False),
    ('config','c',True),
    ('log-dir-path',None,True),
    ('log-name-format',None,True),
    ('sunday-start',None,False),
    ('first-line-section',None,False),
    ('password',None,True),
    ('encrypt',None,False),
    ('decrypt',None,False),
]
_OPT_BY_LONG={o[0]:o for o in _OPTIONS}
_OPT_BY_SHORT={o[1]:o for o in _OPTIONS if o[1]}

def _cli_error(msg):
    raise AppError(msg)

def parse_cli(argv):
    occurrences=[]  # list of (canonical, value or True) in order
    def register(canonical, value=True):
        occurrences.append((canonical,value))
    i=0
    sep=False
    while i < len(argv):
        tok=argv[i]; i+=1
        if sep:
            continue
        if tok == '--':
            sep=True; continue
        if tok == '-' or tok == '' or not tok.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if tok.startswith('--'):
            body=tok[2:]
            if body.startswith('='):
                if body == '=':
                    _cli_error('the argument for option should follow immediately after the equal sign')
                continue
            if '=' in body:
                name_str, inline = body.split('=',1)
                has_inline=True
            else:
                name_str=body; inline=None; has_inline=False
            # resolve
            if name_str in _OPT_BY_LONG:
                canonical=name_str
            else:
                cand=[o[0] for o in _OPTIONS if o[0].startswith(name_str)] if name_str else []
                if len(cand)==0:
                    _cli_error(f"unrecognised option '{tok}'")
                if len(cand)>1:
                    if len(cand)==2:
                        _cli_error(f"option '--{name_str}' is ambiguous and matches '--{cand[0]}', and '--{cand[1]}'")
                    else:
                        lst=', '.join(f"'--{c}'" for c in cand[:-1]) + f", and '--{cand[-1]}'"
                        _cli_error(f"option '--{name_str}' is ambiguous and matches {lst}")
                canonical=cand[0]
            takes=_OPT_BY_LONG[canonical][2]
            if not takes:
                if has_inline:
                    _cli_error(f"option '--{canonical}' does not take any arguments")
                register(canonical,True)
            else:
                if has_inline:
                    if inline=='':
                        _cli_error(f"the argument for option '--{canonical}' should follow immediately after the equal sign")
                    register(canonical,inline)
                else:

def _aes_encrypt_block(block, round_keys):
    a0=int.from_bytes(block[0:4],'big') ^ round_keys[0]
    a1=int.from_bytes(block[4:8],'big') ^ round_keys[1]
    a2=int.from_bytes(block[8:12],'big') ^ round_keys[2]
    a3=int.from_bytes(block[12:16],'big') ^ round_keys[3]
    Te0=_TE0; Te1=_TE1; Te2=_TE2; Te3=_TE3
    for rnd in range(1,10):
        rk=round_keys[rnd*4:rnd*4+4]
        b0=Te0[(a0>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a1>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a2>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a3&0xff]^rk[0]
        b1=Te0[(a1>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a2>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a3>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a0&0xff]^rk[1]
        b2=Te0[(a2>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a3>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a0>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a1&0xff]^rk[2]
        b3=Te0[(a3>>24)&0xff]^Te1[(a0>>16)&0xff]^Te2[(a1>>8)&0xff]^Te3[a2&0xff]^rk[3]
        a0,a1,a2,a3=b0,b1,b2,b3
    # final round
    S=_SBOX; rk=round_keys[40:44]
    out=bytearray(16)
    words_in=[a0,a1,a2,a3]
    # Construct output words then xor rk
    def final_word(w0,w1,w2,w3):
        return ((S[(w0>>24)&0xff]<<24)|(S[(w1>>16)&0xff]<<16)|(S[(w2>>8)&0xff]<<8)|S[w3&0xff])
    o0=final_word(a0,a1,a2,a3)^rk[0]
    o1=final_word(a1,a2,a3,a0)^rk[1]
    o2=final_word(a2,a3,a0,a1)^rk[2]
    o3=final_word(a3,a0,a1,a2)^rk[3]
    return o0.to_bytes(4,'big')+o1.to_bytes(4,'big')+o2.to_bytes(4,'big')+o3.to_bytes(4,'big')

def evp_key_iv(password_bytes):
    d1=hashlib.md5(password_bytes).digest()
    d2=hashlib.md5(d1+password_bytes).digest()
    return d1,d2

def aes_cfb128(data: bytes, password_bytes: bytes, decrypt=False):
    if not data:
        return b''
    key,iv=evp_key_iv(password_bytes)
    rk=_aes_key_expand(key)
    out=bytearray(len(data))
    feedback=iv
    pos=0
    while pos < len(data):
        ks=_aes_encrypt_block(feedback, rk)
        chunk_len=min(16, len(data)-pos)
        chunk=data[pos:pos+chunk_len]
        enc=bytes(c ^ ks[i] for i,c in enumerate(chunk))
        out[pos:pos+chunk_len]=enc
        if chunk_len==16:
            feedback = chunk if decrypt else enc
        pos += chunk_len
    return bytes(out)

# ---------------- CLI parsing (Boost program_options-like) ----------------

@dataclass
class Cli:
    help: bool=False
    config: Optional[str]=None
    log_dir_path: Optional[str]=None
    log_name_format: Optional[str]=None
    sunday_start: bool=False
    first_line_section: bool=False
    password: Optional[str]=None
    encrypt: bool=False
    decrypt: bool=False

_OPTIONS=[
    # canonical, short, takes_value
    ('help','h',False),
    ('config','c',True),
    ('log-dir-path',None,True),
    ('log-name-format',None,True),
    ('sunday-start',None,False),
    ('first-line-section',None,False),
    ('password',None,True),
    ('encrypt',None,False),
    ('decrypt',None,False),
]
_OPT_BY_LONG={o[0]:o for o in _OPTIONS}
_OPT_BY_SHORT={o[1]:o for o in _OPTIONS if o[1]}

def _cli_error(msg):
    raise AppError(msg)

def parse_cli(argv):
    occurrences=[]  # list of (canonical, value or True) in order
    def register(canonical, value=True):
        occurrences.append((canonical,value))
    i=0
    sep=False
    while i < len(argv):
        tok=argv[i]; i+=1
        if sep:
            continue
        if tok == '--':
            sep=True; continue
        if tok == '-' or tok == '' or not tok.startswith('-'):
            continue
        if tok.startswith('--'):
            body=tok[2:]
            if body.startswith('='):
                if body == '=':
                    _cli_error('the argument for option should follow immediately after the equal sign')
                continue
            if '=' in body:
                name_str, inline = body.split('=',1)
                has_inline=True
            else:
                name_str=body; inline=None; has_inline=False
            # resolve
            if name_str in _OPT_BY_LONG:
                canonical=name_str
            else:
                cand=[o[0] for o in _OPTIONS if o[0].startswith(name_str)] if name_str else []
                if len(cand)==0:
                    _cli_error(f"unrecognised option '{tok}'")
                if len(cand)>1:
                    if len(cand)==2:
                        _cli_error(f"option '--{name_str}' is ambiguous and matches '--{cand[0]}', and '--{cand[1]}'")
                    else:
                        lst=', '.join(f"'--{c}'" for c in cand[:-1]) + f", and '--{cand[-1]}'"
                        _cli_error(f"option '--{name_str}' is ambiguous and matches {lst}")
                canonical=cand[0]
            takes=_OPT_BY_LONG[canonical][2]
            if not takes:
                if has_inline:
                    _cli_error(f"option '--{canonical}' does not take any arguments")
                register(canonical,True)
            else:
                if has_inline:
                    if inline=='':
                        _cli_error(f"the argument for option '--{canonical}' should follow immediately after the equal sign")
                    register(canonical,inline)
                else:
                    if i>=len(argv) or argv[i] in ('-h','-c'):
                        _cli_error(f"the required argument for option '--{canonical}' is missing")
                    register(canonical,argv[i]); i+=1
            continue
        else:
            # short
            j=1
            while j < len(tok):
                ch=tok[j]
                if ch not in _OPT_BY_SHORT:
                    _cli_error(f"unrecognised option '{tok}'")
                canonical=_OPT_BY_SHORT[ch][0]
                takes=_OPT_BY_SHORT[ch][2]
                if not takes:
                    register(canonical,True); j+=1; continue
                else:
                    rest=tok[j+1:]
                    if rest != '':
                        register(canonical,rest)
                    else:
                        if i>=len(argv) or argv[i] in ('-h','-c'):
                            _cli_error(f"the required argument for option '--{canonical}' is missing")
                        register(canonical,argv[i]); i+=1
                    break
            continue
    # duplicate check in occurrence order
    seen=set()
    for canonical,val in occurrences:
        if canonical in seen:
            _cli_error(f"option '--{canonical}' cannot be specified more than once")
        seen.add(canonical)
    cli=Cli()
    for canonical,val in occurrences:
        if canonical=='help': cli.help=True
        elif canonical=='config': cli.config=val
        elif canonical=='log-dir-path': cli.log_dir_path=val
        elif canonical=='log-name-format': cli.log_name_format=val
        elif canonical=='sunday-start': cli.sunday_start=True
        elif canonical=='first-line-section': cli.first_line_section=True
        elif canonical=='password': cli.password=val
        elif canonical=='encrypt': cli.encrypt=True
        elif canonical=='decrypt': cli.decrypt=True
    return cli

# ---------------- INI (Boost property_tree ini-like literal tree) ----------------

class PNode:
    __slots__=('data','children')
    def __init__(self,data=''):
        self.data=data
        self.children=[]  # list of (key,PNode)
    def direct(self,key):
        for k,v in self.children:
            if k==key: return v
        return None
    def has_direct(self,key):
        return any(k==key for k,_ in self.children)
    def get_direct(self,key,default=None):
        v=self.direct(key)
        return v.data if v is not None else default

_WS=' \t\r\n\v\f'
def _trim(s):
    return s.strip(_WS)

def read_ini_file(path):
    # directory special-case (libstdc++ ifstream reading a directory)
    try:
        if os.path.isdir(path):
            raise AppError('basic_filebuf::underflow error reading the file: Is a directory')
    except AppError:
        raise
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        with open(path,'rb') as f:
            raw=f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise AppError(f'Failed to open file: {fs_str(path)}')
    except IsADirectoryError:
        raise AppError('basic_filebuf::underflow error reading the file: Is a directory')
    except OSError:
        raise AppError(f'Failed to open file: {fs_str(path)}')
    text=raw.decode('utf-8','surrogateescape')
    lines=text.split('\n')
    root=PNode('')
    current=root
    def parse_err(lineno,msg):
        raise AppError(f'Failed to parse configuration file: <unspecified file>({lineno}): {msg}')
    for idx,rawline in enumerate(lines):
        lineno=idx+1
        # When file ends with newline, split creates a trailing empty entry which is not a real line; it is empty anyway.
        line=_trim(rawline)
        if line=='':
            continue
        if line[0] in ';#':
            continue
        if line[0]=='[':
            close=line.find(']')
            if close<0:
                parse_err(lineno,"unmatched '['")
            inside=line[1:close]
            section_name=_trim(inside)
            # special: all-whitespace inside keeps the raw inside as the key (and is not duplicate-checked)
            is_ws_name = (section_name=='' and inside!='')
            sec_key = inside if is_ws_name else section_name
            if not is_ws_name and root.has_direct(sec_key):
                parse_err(lineno,'duplicate section name')
            node=PNode('')
            root.children.append((sec_key,node))
            current=node
            continue
        eq=line.find('=')
        if eq<0:
            parse_err(lineno,"'=' character not found in line")
        key=_trim(line[:eq]); value=_trim(line[eq+1:])
        if key=='':
            parse_err(lineno,'key expected')
        if current.has_direct(key):
            parse_err(lineno,'duplicate key name')
        current.children.append((key,PNode(value)))
    return root

def ptree_get_bool(node, key, default=False):
    if node is None: return default
    v=node.direct(key)
    if v is None: return default
    s=v.data
    if s=='true' or s=='1': return True
    if s=='false' or s=='0': return False
    return default

def ptree_get_uint32(node, key, default=0):
    if node is None: return default
    v=node.direct(key)
    if v is None: return default
    s=v.data
    return parse_uint32_or_default(s, default)

def parse_uint32_or_default(s, default):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[+-]?\d+', s or ''):
        return default
    try:
        val=int(s,10)
    except Exception:
        return default
    if 0 <= val <= 4294967295:
        return val
    if val < 0 and val >= -4294967295:
        return val % 4294967296
    return default

{"command":"cat >> caps_log.py << 'PYEOF'

# ---------------- rendering (attached to App) ----------------

def _style_cell(style: Style, dim=False, extra=0):
    return style_to_cell(style, (DIM if dim else 0) | extra)

def _draw_filled_box(app, grid, x,y,w,h,border,style,title=None,fill_style=None):
    # fill interior/background first with spaces using fill_style (or border style)
    fs = fill_style if fill_style is not None else style
    for yy in range(y,y+h):
        for xx in range(x,x+w):
            if grid.inb(xx,yy):
                grid.set(xx,yy,' ',fs)
    draw_box(grid,x,y,w,h,border,style,title)

def _draw_menu(app, grid, x,y,w,h,title,labels,selected,focused,border, hit_kind):
    dim = not focused
    bstyle = cell_style(DIM if dim else 0)
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,x,y,w,h,border,bstyle,title,fill_style=bstyle)
    app._hit_regions.append((hit_kind,x,y,x+w-1,y+h-1,None))
    inner_w=max(0,w-2); inner_h=max(0,h-2)
    if inner_h<=0 or inner_w<=0:
        return 17
    total=len(labels)
    start=0
    if total>inner_h:
        start=max(0,min(selected-((inner_h-1)//2), total-inner_h))
    has_scroll = total>inner_h
    entry_w = inner_w-1 if has_scroll else inner_w
    # scrollbar chars
    scroll_chars=[]
    if has_scroll:
        Hh=inner_h; T=total
        def rhu(num,den): return (2*num+den)//(2*den)  # not used
        a=int((start*(2*Hh))/T + 0.5)
        b=int(((start+Hh)*(2*Hh))/T + 0.5)
        for r in range(inner_h):
            units=[u for u in (2*r,2*r+1) if a<=u<b]
            if len(units)==2: scroll_chars.append('┃')
            elif units==[2*r]: scroll_chars.append('╹')
            elif units==[2*r+1]: scroll_chars.append('╻')
            else: scroll_chars.append(' ')
    for r in range(inner_h):
        idx=start+r
        if idx>=total: break
        label=labels[idx]
        is_sel=(idx==selected)
        attrs=0
        if is_sel:
            attrs|=BOLD
            if focused: attrs|=INVERT
        if dim: attrs|=DIM
        st=cell_style(attrs)
        text=('> ' if is_sel else '  ')+label
        # draw padded to entry width
        # truncate by display width
        # Build a string truncated to entry_w columns
        disp=''; dw=0
        for ch in text:
            cw=_char_width(ch)
            if cw==0:
                continue
            if dw+cw>entry_w: break
            disp+=ch; dw+=cw
        disp=disp+' '*(entry_w-dw)
        grid.text(x+1,y+1+r,disp,st,clip_x1=x+1+entry_w)
        app._hit_regions.append((hit_kind,x+1,y+1+r,x+entry_w,y+1+r,idx))
        if has_scroll:
            grid.set(x+w-2,y+1+r,scroll_chars[r],cell_style(DIM if dim else 0))
    # page step from this box height
    return max(1,inner_h-1)

def _render_annual(app, grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    cfg=app.cfg; theme=cfg.annual_theme
    loaded = (app.phase!='password')
    focus = app.focus if loaded else -1
    def is_dim(comp_idx):
        return focus!=comp_idx
    # header
    count=len(app.entries) if loaded else 0
    evt=app.todays_event_text() if loaded else ''
    header=f"Today is: {fmt_date_dots(app.today,True)} {evt} | There are {count} log entries for year {app.selected_date.y}."
    # calendar geometry
    mpr = 6 if W>=204 else 4
    groups=[]
    months=list(range(1,13))
    for gi in range(0,12,mpr):
        grp=months[gi:gi+mpr]
        maxweeks=0
        for m in grp:
            first=Date(app.selected_date.y,m,1)
            col0=((first.weekday()+1)%7) if cfg.sunday_start else first.weekday()
            weeks=(col0+days_in_month(first.y,m)+6)//7
            maxweeks=max(maxweeks,weeks)
        groups.append((grp,maxweeks+3))
    year_nat_h=2+sum(h for _,h in groups)
    ev_lines,ev_count=app.recent_event_lines() if loaded else ([],0)
    events_nat_h=min(2+len(ev_lines),10)
    left_nat_h=20+events_nat_h
    top_nat_h=max(left_nat_h, year_nat_h)
    top_nat_w=50+2+mpr*23
    total_nat=1+top_nat_h+14+1
    if total_nat<=H:
        y0=(H-total_nat)//2; top_h=top_nat_h; preview_h=14; help_h=1
    else:
        y0=0; help_h=0
        avail=max(0,H-1)
        # shrink: drop help, then shrink preview somewhat more than top (heuristic tuned to observed FTXUI)
        # Start from natural and remove deficit alternating preview/top at ratio ~ 2:1
        deficit=(top_nat_h+14)-avail
        preview_h=14; top_h=top_nat_h
        while deficit>0:
            # preview first two, then top one, repeat (rough)
            for target in ('preview','preview','top'):
                if deficit<=0: break
                if target=='preview' and preview_h>3:
                    preview_h-=1; deficit-=1
                elif target=='top' and top_h>5:
                    top_h-=1; deficit-=1
            if preview_h<=3 and top_h<=5:
                break
        # if still too tall, truncate top
        if 1+top_h+preview_h>H:
            preview_h=max(0,H-1-top_h)
    # header at y0
    hstyle=cell_style(BOLD|UNDER)
    hx=(W-text_width(header))//2
    grid.text(hx,y0,header,hstyle)
    top_y=y0+1
    top_alloc_w=min(W,top_nat_w)
    x_top=(W-top_alloc_w)//2 if top_alloc_w<W else 0
    # left / year widths
    if top_alloc_w>=top_nat_w:
        left_w=50; sec_w=25; tag_w=25; year_w=top_nat_w-50
    else:
        if top_alloc_w>=100:
            left_w=50
        else:
            left_w=max(10, top_alloc_w//2)
        sec_w=(left_w+1)//2; tag_w=left_w-sec_w; year_w=top_alloc_w-left_w
    # left heights
    if top_h>=left_nat_h:
        menu_h=20; events_h=events_nat_h
    else:
        events_h=max(2,min(events_nat_h, max(2,top_h-5)))
        menu_h=max(3,top_h-events_h)
        if menu_h+events_h>top_h:
            events_h=max(0,top_h-menu_h)
    # menus
    if loaded:
        sec_labels=[('<select none>' if n is None else f"{c:3d} │ {n}") for n,c in app.sections]
        tag_labels=[('<select none>' if n is None else f"{c:3d} │ {n}") for n,c in app.tags]
    else:
        sec_labels=[]; tag_labels=[]
    app._menu_page_step=_draw_menu(app,grid,x_top,top_y,sec_w,menu_h,'Sections',sec_labels,app.sec_idx if loaded else -1,focus==0,theme.sections_menu_border,'menu_sec')
    _draw_menu(app,grid,x_top+sec_w,top_y,tag_w,menu_h,'Tags',tag_labels,app.tag_idx if loaded else -1,focus==1,theme.tags_menu_border,'menu_tag')
    # events box
    if events_h>=2:
        ev_title=f"Recent & upcoming events ({ev_count})"
        ev_style=cell_style(DIM)
        _draw_filled_box(app,grid,x_top,top_y+menu_h,left_w,events_h,theme.events_list_border,ev_style,ev_title,fill_style=ev_style)
        cap_lines=max(0,events_h-2)
        has_scroll=len(ev_lines)>cap_lines and cap_lines>0
        inner_w=max(0,left_w-2)
        text_w=inner_w-1 if has_scroll else inner_w
        scroll_chars=[]
        if has_scroll:
            Hh=cap_lines; T=len(ev_lines); a=0; b=int((Hh*(2*Hh))/T+0.5)
            for r in range(cap_lines):
                units=[u for u in (2*r,2*r+1) if a<=u<b]
                scroll_chars.append('┃' if len(units)==2 else ('╹' if units==[2*r] else ('╻' if units==[2*r+1] else ' ')))
        for r,line in enumerate(ev_lines[:cap_lines]):
            grid.text(x_top+1,top_y+menu_h+1+r,line,ev_style,clip_x1=x_top+1+text_w)
            if has_scroll:
                grid.set(x_top+left_w-2,top_y+menu_h+1+r,scroll_chars[r],ev_style)
    # calendar year box
    cal_x=x_top+left_w; cal_y=top_y; cal_w=year_w; cal_h=top_h
    cal_dim=is_dim(2)
    cal_border_style=cell_style(DIM if cal_dim else 0)
    if cal_w>0 and cal_h>0:
        _draw_filled_box(app,grid,cal_x,cal_y,cal_w,cal_h,theme.calendar_border,cal_border_style,str(app.selected_date.y),fill_style=cal_border_style)
        app._hit_regions.append(('calendar',cal_x,cal_y,cal_x+cal_w-1,cal_y+cal_h-1,None))
        # month row allocations
        inner_h=max(0,cal_h-2)
        nat_sum=sum(h for _,h in groups)
        row_alloc=[]
        if inner_h>=nat_sum:
            row_alloc=[h for _,h in groups]
        else:
            # proportional shrink min 4
            remaining=inner_h
            alloc=[]
            for idx,(_,h) in enumerate(groups):
                if idx==len(groups)-1:
                    a=max(0,remaining)
                else:
                    a=max(4,int(h*inner_h/nat_sum)) if nat_sum else 4
                    a=min(a,remaining)
                alloc.append(a); remaining-=a
            row_alloc=alloc
        my=cal_y+1
        # month box widths: natural 23 each, distribute if year inner width differs
        year_inner_w=max(0,cal_w-2)
        # If inner width >= mpr*23, boxes are 23 (extra blank on right inside year). If less, distribute.
        if year_inner_w>=mpr*23:
            month_ws=[23]*mpr
        else:
            basew=year_inner_w//mpr if mpr else 0; rem=year_inner_w-basew*mpr
            month_ws=[basew+(1 if i<rem else 0) for i in range(mpr)]
        for gi,(grp,nat_h) in enumerate(groups):
            rh=row_alloc[gi] if gi<len(row_alloc) else nat_h
            if rh<=0:
                continue
            mx=cal_x+1
            for ci,m in enumerate(grp):
                mw=month_ws[ci] if ci<len(month_ws) else 23
                if mw>0:
                    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,mx,my,mw,rh,theme.calendar_month_border,cal_border_style,MONTH_NAMES[m-1],fill_style=cal_border_style)
                    if rh>=2 and mw>=2:
                        # weekday header
                        labels=['S','M','T','W','T','F','S'] if cfg.sunday_start else ['M','T','W','T','F','S','S']
                        hdr=' '+'  '.join(labels)+' '
                        wh_style=cell_style((DIM if cal_dim else 0)|UNDER)
                        grid.text(mx+1,my+1,hdr,wh_style,clip_x1=mx+mw-1)
                    # dates
                    first=Date(app.selected_date.y,m,1)
                    col0=((first.weekday()+1)%7) if cfg.sunday_start else first.weekday()
                    dimd=days_in_month(first.y,m)
                    weeks=(col0+dimd+6)//7
                    max_week_rows=max(0,rh-3)
                    for day in range(1,dimd+1):
                        p=col0+day-1; wr=p//7; wc=p%7
                        if wr>=max_week_rows: continue
                        dt=Date(first.y,m,day)
                        dx=mx+1+wc*3; dy=my+2+wr
                        if dx>=mx+mw-1: continue
                        # style layers
                        cur=(COLOR_DEFAULT,COLOR_DEFAULT,0)
                        def apply(cur,sty):
                            fg,bg,at=cur
                            if sty.fg.kind!='default': fg=sty.fg
                            if sty.bg.kind!='default': bg=sty.bg
                            at |= (BOLD if sty.bold else 0)|(DIM if sty.dim else 0)|(ITALIC if sty.italic else 0)|(UNDER if sty.underlined else 0)|(BLINK if sty.blink else 0)|(INVERT if sty.inverted else 0)|(STRIKE if sty.strikethrough else 0)
                            return (fg,bg,at)
                        is_event=False
                        if loaded:
                            for evs in cfg.events_by_cat.values():
                                for ev in evs:
                                    if ev.month==m and ev.day==day: is_event=True; break
                        if is_event: cur=apply(cur,theme.event_date)
                        has_log=dt in app.entries
                        cur=apply(cur, theme.log_date if has_log else theme.empty_date)
                        if dt.weekday()>=5: cur=apply(cur,theme.weekend_date)
                        if loaded and app.is_highlighted(dt): cur=apply(cur,theme.highlighted_date)
                        if dt==app.today: cur=apply(cur,theme.todays_date)
                        fg,bg,at=cur
                        if focus==2 and dt==app.selected_date: at|=INVERT
                        if cal_dim: at|=DIM
                        txt=f"{day:2d}"
                        grid.text(dx,dy,txt,(fg,bg,at),clip_x1=mx+mw-1)
                        app._hit_regions.append(('cal_date',dx,dy,min(dx+1,mx+mw-2),dy,dt))
                mx+=mw
            my+=rh
    # preview
    preview_y=top_y+top_h
    rendered_lines=[]
    longest=0
    if loaded:
        e=app.entries.get(app.selected_date)
        if e is not None:
            rendered_lines=render_markdown(e.content, theme.markdown)
            for ml in rendered_lines:
                longest=max(longest, sum(text_width(t) for t,_ in ml.segments))
    base_preview_w=top_nat_w+1
    desired_preview_w=max(base_preview_w, longest+2)
    preview_w=min(W,desired_preview_w)
    preview_x=(W-preview_w)//2 if preview_w<W else 0
    preview_dim=is_dim(3)
    prev_border_style=cell_style(DIM if preview_dim else 0)
    if preview_h>=2 and preview_w>0:
        _draw_filled_box(app,grid,preview_x,preview_y,preview_w,preview_h,theme.log_entry_preview_border,prev_border_style,None,fill_style=prev_border_style)
        app._hit_regions.append(('preview',preview_x,preview_y,preview_x+preview_w-1,preview_y+preview_h-1,None))
        if not loaded:
            grid.text(preview_x+1,preview_y+1,'log preview',cell_style(DIM if preview_dim else 0))
        else:
            title=f"log preview for {fmt_date_dots(app.selected_date)}"
            # title row: whole row bold, title underlined
            rowstyle=cell_style(BOLD|(DIM if preview_dim else 0))
            # fill title row spaces with rowstyle
            for xx in range(preview_x+1,preview_x+preview_w-1):
                if grid.inb(xx,preview_y+1): grid.set(xx,preview_y+1,' ',rowstyle)
            tx=preview_x+(preview_w-text_width(title))//2
            grid.text(tx,preview_y+1,title,cell_style(BOLD|UNDER|(DIM if preview_dim else 0)))
            content_rows=max(0,preview_h-3)
            app._preview_rendered=rendered_lines
            for r in range(content_rows):
                idx=app.preview_scroll+r
                if idx>=len(rendered_lines): break
                ml=rendered_lines[idx]
                yy=preview_y+2+r
                if ml.full_style is not None:
                    fs=style_to_cell(ml.full_style, DIM if preview_dim else 0)
                    for xx in range(preview_x+1,preview_x+preview_w-1):
                        if grid.inb(xx,yy): grid.set(xx,yy,' ',fs)
                cx=preview_x+1
                for text,sty in ml.segments:
                    cs=style_to_cell(sty, DIM if preview_dim else 0)
                    cx=grid.text(cx,yy,text,cs,clip_x1=preview_x+preview_w-1)
                    if cx>=preview_x+preview_w-1: break
    if help_h:
        help_txt='hjkl/arrow keys - navigation | d - delete log | s - see scratchpads | tab - move focus between menus and calendar'
        hx=(W-text_width(help_txt))//2
        grid.text(hx,preview_y+preview_h,help_txt,cell_style(DIM))

def _render_scratch(app, grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h; cfg=app.cfg; theme=cfg.scratch_theme
    # width / height allocation
    if W<=180:
        content_w=W; x0=0
    else:
        extra=W-180; content_w=180+(extra*3)//4; x0=(W-content_w)//2
    natural_h=27
    if H>=natural_h:
        y0=(H-natural_h)//3; box_h=24; show_help=True
    else:
        y0=0; box_h=max(2,H-2); show_help=False
    title='Scratchpad Manager'
    grid.text(x0+(content_w-text_width(title))//2,y0,title,cell_style(BOLD|UNDER))
    if y0+1<H:
        draw_hline(grid,x0,y0+1,content_w,cell_style(0))
    # left menu width
    if content_w>=180:
        menu_w=45

        title2=selected.name if selected else 'Select a scratchpad'

        tx=px+(preview_w-text_width(title2))//2
        grid.text(tx,py+1,title2,cell_style(BOLD|UNDER|DIM))

def _draw_modal(app,grid):
    m=app.modal

    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    title=m.get('title','')
    has_input='input' in m
    disp_len=0; field_w=0

        txt=m['input']

    btns=m.get('buttons',['Ok'])
    btn_total=sum(text_width(b)+2 for b in btns)
    inner_w=max(text_width(title), field_w, btn_total)
    box_w=inner_w+2
    box_h=2+1+1+(1 if has_input else 0)+3
    if box_w>W: box_w=W; inner_w=max(0,box_w-2)
    if box_h>H: box_h=H
    x=(W-box_w)//2; y=(H-box_h)//2
    _draw_filled_box/app,grid,x,y,box_w,box_h,'rounded',cell_style(0),None,fill_style=cell_style(0))
    # title
    if box_h>2:

    if box_h>3:
        draw_hline(grid,x+1,y+2,max(0,box_w-2),cell_style(0))
        # ensure border junction segments at sides are present via box verticals automerge (hline only inner; add endpoints)
        grid.set(x,y+2,'├',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_E,'light')
        grid.set(x+box_w-1,y+2,'┤',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_W,'light')
    cursor=None
    cur_y=y+3
    if has_input and cur_y < y+box_h-1:
        txt=m['input']; is_pw=m.get('password')
        disp='•'*len(txt) if is_pw else txt
        fw=min(field_w,inner_w)
        fx=x+1+(inner_w-fw)//2
        focused_input=(m.get('focus')=='input')
        # field background
        if len(txt)==0:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0)|(DIM),fg=color_ansi16(15))
            # When button focused, placeholder in reference is dim fg97 no invert: DIM handles, INVERT only focused
            for xx in range(fx,fx+fw):
                grid.set(xx,cur_y,' ',fst)
            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+max(0,fw-1),cur_y)
        else:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0),fg=color_ansi16(15))
            # display window if text wider than field (field normally fits)
            start_chars=0
            # simple: if disp width > fw, show around cursor
            disp_text=disp
            if text_width(disp_text)+1>fw:
                # show last fw-1 chars approx
                # cut by characters from left such that cursor visible
                cur=m['cursor']
                # take a window ending at max(cur, fw-1)
                end=max(cur,fw-1); start_chars=max(0,end-(fw-1))
                disp_text=disp[start_chars:start_chars+fw]
            for xx in range(fx,fx+fw):
                grid.set(xx,cur_y,' ',fst)
            grid.text(fx,cur_y,disp_text,fst,clip_x1=fx+fw)
            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+min(fw-1, max(0,m['cursor']-start_chars)),cur_y) if False else (fx+min(fw, m['cursor']-start_chars),cur_y)
                # cursor x should be field start + (cursor-start_chars); cap inside screen
                cursor=(min(fx+(m['cursor']-start_chars), x+box_w-2),cur_y)
        app._hit_regions.append(('modal_input',fx,cur_y,fx+fw-1,cur_y,fx))
        cur_y+=1
    # buttons
    if cur_y+2 < y+box_h:
        total=btn_total; bx=x+1+(inner_w-total)//2

            focused=(m.get('focus')=='buttons' and m.get('btn_idx',0)==bi)

    return cursor

def _draw_loading_small(app,grid):

    x=(grid.w-box_w)//2; y=(grid.h-box_h)//2

    grid.text(x+1,y+1,text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)

def _draw_loading_full(app,grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,0,0,W,H,'rounded',cell_style(0),'Loading...',fill_style=cell_style(0))
    if H>1:
        grid.text(1,1,app.git_error_text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=W-1)
    # message Ok dialog centered
    text=app.git_error_text
    inner_w=text_width(text); box_w=min(W,inner_w+2); box_h=7
    x=(W-box_w)//2; y=(H-box_h)//2
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,x,y,box_w,box_h,'rounded',cell_style(0),None,fill_style=cell_style(0))
    grid.text(x+1,y+1,text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)

    grid.set(x,y+2,'├',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_E,'light'); grid.set(x+box_w-1,y+2,'┤',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_W,'light')
    bw=text_width('Ok')+2; bx=x+(box_w-bw)//2
    _draw_button(app,grid,bx,y+3,'Ok',True,0)

def _app_render(app):
    app.term.width,app.term.height=app.term.get_size()
    W,H=app.term.width,app.term.height
    grid=Grid(W,H); app._hit_regions=[]
    cursor=None
    if app.phase=='git_error':
        _draw_loading_full(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.view=='annual':
        _render_annual(app,grid)
    else:
        _render_scratch(app,grid)
    if app.pull_running or app.pull_stuck:
        grid.add_dim_all()
        _draw_loading_small(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.show_help:
        grid.add_dim_all(); _draw_help(app,grid); return grid,None
    if app.modal is not None:
        grid.add_dim_all(); cursor=_draw_modal(app,grid)
        return grid,cursor
    return grid,None

App.render=_app_render

# ---------------- rendering (attached to App) ----------------

def _style_cell(style: Style, dim=False, extra=0):
    return style_to_cell(style, (DIM if dim else 0) | extra)

def _draw_filled_box(app, grid, x,y,w,h,border,style,title=None,fill_style=None):
    # fill interior/background first with spaces using fill_style (or border style)
    fs = fill_style if fill_style is not None else style
    for yy in range(y,y+h):
        for xx in range(x,x+w):
            if grid.inb(xx,yy):
                grid.set(xx,yy,' ',fs)
    draw_box(grid,x,y,w,h,border,style,title)

def _draw_menu(app, grid, x,y,w,h,title,labels,selected,focused,border, hit_kind):
    dim = not focused
    bstyle = cell_style(DIM if dim else 0)
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,x,y,w,h,border,bstyle,title,fill_style=bstyle)
    app._hit_regions.append((hit_kind,x,y,x+w-1,y+h-1,None))
    inner_w=max(0,w-2); inner_h=max(0,h-2)
    if inner_h<=0 or inner_w<=0:
        return 17
    total=len(labels)
    start=0
    if total>inner_h:
        start=max(0,min(selected-((inner_h-1)//2), total-inner_h))
    has_scroll = total>inner_h
    entry_w = inner_w-1 if has_scroll else inner_w
    # scrollbar chars
    scroll_chars=[]
    if has_scroll:
        Hh=inner_h; T=total
        def rhu(num,den): return (2*num+den)//(2*den)  # not used
        a=int((start*(2*Hh))/T + 0.5)
        b=int(((start+Hh)*(2*Hh))/T + 0.5)
        for r in range(inner_h):
            units=[u for u in (2*r,2*r+1) if a<=u<b]
            if len(units)==2: scroll_chars.append('┃')
            elif units==[2*r]: scroll_chars.append('╹')
            elif units==[2*r+1]: scroll_chars.append('╻')
            else: scroll_chars.append(' ')
    for r in range(inner_h):
        idx=start+r
        if idx>=total: break
        label=labels[idx]
        is_sel=(idx==selected)
        attrs=0
        if is_sel:
            attrs|=BOLD
            if focused: attrs|=INVERT
        if dim: attrs|=DIM
        st=cell_style(attrs)
        text=('> ' if is_sel else '  ')+label
        # draw padded to entry width
        # truncate by display width
        # Build a string truncated to entry_w columns
        disp=''; dw=0
        for ch in text:
            cw=_char_width(ch)
            if cw==0:
                continue
            if dw+cw>entry_w: break
            disp+=ch; dw+=cw
        disp=disp+' '*(entry_w-dw)
        grid.text(x+1,y+1+r,disp,st,clip_x1=x+1+entry_w)
        app._hit_regions.append((hit_kind,x+1,y+1+r,x+entry_w,y+1+r,idx))
        if has_scroll:
            grid.set(x+w-2,y+1+r,scroll_chars[r],cell_style(DIM if dim else 0))
    # page step from this box height
    return max(1,inner_h-1)

def _render_annual(app, grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    cfg=app.cfg; theme=cfg.annual_theme
    loaded = (app.phase!='password')

        deficit=(top_nat_h+14)-avail

            for target in ('preview','preview','top'):

    cursor=None
    cur_y=y+3
    if has_input and cur_y < y+box_h-1:
        txt=m['input']; is_pw=m.get('password')

        fw=min(field_w,inner_w)

        if len(txt)==0:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0)|(DIM),fg=color_ansi16(15))

            for xx in range(fx,fx+fw):

            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+max(0,fw-1),cur_y)
        else:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0),fg=color_ansi16(15))
            # display window if text wider than field (field normally fits)
            start_chars=0
            # simple: if disp width > fw, show around cursor
            disp_text=disp
            if text_width(disp_text)+1>fw:
                # show last fw-1 chars approx

                cur=m['cursor']

                end=max(cur,fw-1); start_chars=max(0,end-(fw-1))

            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+min(fw-1, max(0,m['cursor']-start_chars)),cur_y) if False else (fx+min(fw, m['cursor']-start_chars),cur_y)
                # cursor x should be field start + (cursor-start_chars); cap inside screen
                cursor=(min(fx+(m['cursor']-start_chars), x+box_w-2),cur_y)
        app._hit_regions.append(('modal_input',fx,cur_y,fx+fw-1,cur_y,fx))

def _app_render(app):
    app.term.width,app.term.height=app.term.get_size()
    W,H=app.term.width,app.term.height
    grid=Grid(W,H); app._hit_regions=[]
    cursor=None
    if app.phase=='git_error':
        _draw_loading_full(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.view=='annual':
        _render_annual(app,grid)
    else:
        _render_scratch(app,grid)
    if app.pull_running or app.pull_stuck:
        grid.add_dim_all()
        _draw_loading_small(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.show_help:
        grid.add_dim_all(); _draw_help(app,grid); return grid,None
    if app.modal is not None:
        grid.add_dim_all(); cursor=_draw_modal(app,grid)
        return grid,cursor
    return grid,None

        Hh=inner_h; T=total
        def rhu(num,den): return (2*num+den)//(2*den)  # not used
        a=int((start*(2*Hh))/T + 0.5)

        label=labels[idx]

def _render_scratch(app, grid):

    title='Scratchpad Manager'
    grid.text(x0+(content_w-text_width(title))//2,y0,title,cell_style(BOLD|UNDER))
    if y0+1<H:
        draw_hline(grid,x0,y0+1,content_w,cell_style(0))
    # left menu width
    if content_w>=180:

    labels=['Make new scratchpad']
    for it in app.scratch_items:

    app._scratch_page_step=_draw_menu(app,grid,x0,y0+2,menu_w,box_h,'Scratchpads',labels,app.scratch_idx,True,theme.menu_border,'scratch_menu')
    # preview

    if preview_w>0 and box_h>=2:
        _draw_filled_box(app,grid,px,py,preview_w,box_h,theme.preview_border,cell_style(DIM),None,fill_style=cell_style(DIM))
        app._hit_regions.append(('preview',px,py,px+preview_w-1,py+box_h-1,None))
        selected=None
        if app.scratch_idx>0 and app.scratch_idx-1<len(app.scratch_items):

def _draw_button(app,grid,x,y,label,focused,idx):
    w=text_width(label)+2; h=3

    grid.text(x+1,y+1,label,st)
    app._hit_regions.append(('modal_button',x,y,x+w-1,y+h-1,idx))
    return w

def _draw_modal(app,grid):
    m=app.modal
    if not m: return None
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    title=m.get('title','')
    has_input='input' in m
    disp_len=0; field_w=0
    if has_input:
        txt=m['input']
        disp_len=text_width('•'*len(txt) if m.get('password') else txt)
        field_w=max(8, disp_len+1 if len(txt)>0 else 8)
    btns=m.get('buttons',['Ok'])
    btn_total=sum(text_width(b)+2 for b in btns)
    inner_w=max(text_width(title), field_w, btn_total)
    box_w=inner_w+2
    box_h=2+1+1+(1 if has_input else 0)+3
    if box_w>W: box_w=W; inner_w=max(0,box_w-2)
    if box_h>H: box_h=H
    x=(W-box_w)//2; y=(H-box_h)//2
    _draw_filled_box/app,grid,x,y,box_w,box_h,'rounded',cell_style(0),None,fill_style=cell_style(0))
    # title
    if box_h>2:
        grid.text(x+1,y+1,title,cell_style(0),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)
    # separator
    if box_h>3:
        draw_hline(grid,x+1,y+2,max(0,box_w-2),cell_style(0))
        # ensure border junction segments at sides are present via box verticals automerge (hline only inner; add endpoints)
        grid.set(x,y+2,'├',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_E,'light')
        grid.set(x+box_w-1,y+2,'┤',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_W,'light')
    cursor=None
    cur_y=y+3
    if has_input and cur_y < y+box_h-1:
        txt=m['input']; is_pw=m.get('password')
        disp='•'*len(txt) if is_pw else txt
        fw=min(field_w,inner_w)
        fx=x+1+(inner_w-fw)//2
        focused_input=(m.get('focus')=='input')
        # field background
        if len(txt)==0:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0)|(DIM),fg=color_ansi16(15))
            # When button focused, placeholder in reference is dim fg97 no invert: DIM handles, INVERT only focused
            for xx in range(fx,fx+fw):
                grid.set(xx,cur_y,' ',fst)
            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+max(0,fw-1),cur_y)
        else:
            fst=cell_style((INVERT if focused_input else 0),fg=color_ansi16(15))
            # display window if text wider than field (field normally fits)
            start_chars=0
            # simple: if disp width > fw, show around cursor
            disp_text=disp
            if text_width(disp_text)+1>fw:
                # show last fw-1 chars approx
                # cut by characters from left such that cursor visible
                cur=m['cursor']
                # take a window ending at max(cur, fw-1)
                end=max(cur,fw-1); start_chars=max(0,end-(fw-1))
                disp_text=disp[start_chars:start_chars+fw]
            for xx in range(fx,fx+fw):
                grid.set(xx,cur_y,' ',fst)
            grid.text(fx,cur_y,disp_text,fst,clip_x1=fx+fw)
            if focused_input:
                cursor=(fx+min(fw-1, max(0,m['cursor']-start_chars)),cur_y) if False else (fx+min(fw, m['cursor']-start_chars),cur_y)
                # cursor x should be field start + (cursor-start_chars); cap inside screen
                cursor=(min(fx+(m['cursor']-start_chars), x+box_w-2),cur_y)
        app._hit_regions.append(('modal_input',fx,cur_y,fx+fw-1,cur_y,fx))
        cur_y+=1
    # buttons
    if cur_y+2 < y+box_h:
        total=btn_total; bx=x+1+(inner_w-total)//2
        for bi,b in enumerate(btns):
            focused=(m.get('focus')=='buttons' and m.get('btn_idx',0)==bi)
            bw=_draw_button(app,grid,bx,cur_y,b,focused,bi)
            bx+=bw
    return cursor

def _draw_help(app,grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    box_w=min(W,114); box_h=min(H,47)
    x=(W-box_w)//2; y=(H-box_h)//2

    if inner_h>=45:
        content_rows=41; btn_area=3
    else:
        btn_area=1 if inner_h>=3 else 0
        content_rows=max(0,inner_h-1-btn_area)
    md=app.cfg.annual_theme.markdown
    for r in range(min(content_rows,len(content))):
        line=content[r]; yy=y+1+r
        if line=='':
            continue
        if set(line)=={'-'} and len(line)>=3:
            grid.text(x+3,yy,line,cell_style(DIM),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)
        else:

def _draw_loading_small(app,grid):

    grid.text(x+1,y+1,text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)

def _draw_loading_full(app,grid):
    W=grid.w; H=grid.h
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,0,0,W,H,'rounded',cell_style(0),'Loading...',fill_style=cell_style(0))
    if H>1:
        grid.text(1,1,app.git_error_text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=W-1)
    # message Ok dialog centered
    text=app.git_error_text
    inner_w=text_width(text); box_w=min(W,inner_w+2); box_h=7
    x=(W-box_w)//2; y=(H-box_h)//2
    _draw_filled_box(app,grid,x,y,box_w,box_h,'rounded',cell_style(0),None,fill_style=cell_style(0))
    grid.text(x+1,y+1,text,cell_style(0),clip_x1=x+box_w-1)
    draw_hline(grid,x+1,y+2,max(0,box_w-2),cell_style(0))
    grid.set(x,y+2,'├',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_E,'light'); grid.set(x+box_w-1,y+2,'┤',cell_style(0),SEG_N|SEG_S|SEG_W,'light')
    bw=text_width('Ok')+2; bx=x+(box_w-bw)//2
    _draw_button(app,grid,bx,y+3,'Ok',True,0)

def _app_render(app):
    app.term.width,app.term.height=app.term.get_size()
    W,H=app.term.width,app.term.height
    grid=Grid(W,H); app._hit_regions=[]
    cursor=None
    if app.phase=='git_error':
        _draw_loading_full(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.view=='annual':
        _render_annual(app,grid)
    else:
        _render_scratch(app,grid)
    if app.pull_running or app.pull_stuck:
        grid.add_dim_all()
        _draw_loading_small(app,grid)
        return grid,None
    if app.show_help:
        grid.add_dim_all(); _draw_help(app,grid); return grid,None
    if app.modal is not None:
        grid.add_dim_all(); cursor=_draw_modal(app,grid)
        return grid,cursor
    return grid,None

App.render=_app_render

    segs=[]

        st=base_style.copy()

    base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/capsNano')

    out1=tm('capture-pane','-t',sess,'-p').stdout
    tm('send-keys','-t',sess,'-l','HelloNano'); time.sleep(0.3); tm('send-keys','-t',sess,'C-o'); time.sleep(0.3); tm('send-keys','-t',sess,'Enter'); time.sleep(0.3); tm('send-keys','-t',sess,'C-x'); time.sleep(0.8)

import os, pty, subprocess, time, select, fcntl, termios, struct, pathlib, shutil, signal
class PTYApp:
    def __init__(self, base_name, cfg="log-dir-path=LOGDIR\n", files=None,w=180,h=45,env_extra=None):
        self.base=pathlib.Path(f"/tmp/{base_name}")
        if self.base.exists(): shutil.rmtree(self.base)
        (self.base/"home").mkdir(parents=True); (self.base/"logs").mkdir()
        (self.base/"config.ini").write_text(cfg.replace("LOGDIR",str(self.base/"logs")))
        if files:
            for k,v in files.items():
                p=self.base/k; p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); p.write_bytes(v.encode() if isinstance(v,str) else v)
        self.master,self.slave=pty.openpty()
        # set winsize
        fcntl.ioctl(self.slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, struct.pack("HHHH",h,w,0,0))
        env=dict(os.environ); env["HOME"]=str(self.base/"home"); env["TERM"]="xterm-256color"; env["EDITOR"]="cat"
        if env_extra: env.update(env_extra)
        self.proc=subprocess.Popen([str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"executable"),"-c",str(self.base/"config.ini")],stdin=self.slave,stdout=self.slave,stderr=self.slave,env=env,close_fds=True)
        os.close(self.slave)
        self.buf=b""
        self.drain(0.8)
    def drain(self,timeout=0.5):
        end=time.time()+timeout
        while time.time()<end:
            r,_,_=select.select([self.master],[],[],max(0,end-time.time()))
            if not r: break
            try:
                data=os.read(self.master,65536)
            except OSError: break
            if not data: break
            self.buf+=data
        return self.buf
    def send(self,data,wait=0.4):
        self.buf=b""; os.write(self.master,data if isinstance(data,bytes) else data.encode()); return self.drain(wait)
    def close(self):
        try: self.proc.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        except: pass
        time.sleep(0.2)
        try: self.proc.kill()
        except: pass
